basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer from Kansas City, Missouri, juggling a full-time job in IT support while pursuing my passion for gaming. My interests range from competitive gaming, especially on platforms like Mortal Kombat X Mobile and World of Warcraft, to indulging in the rich lore of graphic novels like Watchmen. Not much of a morning person, I usually hop online after work hours, spending most of my evenings and weekends exploring new game strategies or catching up on gaming podcasts. Single and loving the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in IT, acquired through a mix of a degree in Computer Science and years of hands-on experience in tech support. My gaming expertise is mostly self-taught; I've been playing video games since my teens and have a knack for strategic gameplay and staying updated with the latest game patches and strategies.
